payload.posture: Read John 14:15–27 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus joins love and commandments to the Father’s gift of another Counselor, presence with and within the disciples, teaching, remembrance, and peace. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
